title: Aggregation and Grouping
description: Summarize and analyze your data using aggregate functions, GROUP BY, ROLLUP, CUBE, and GROUPING SETS. Essential for reporting and insights.
whatYouLearn: How to use aggregate functions: COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, and MAX
How GROUP BY groups rows to produce summary rows
How HAVING filters groups (as opposed to WHERE which filters rows)
How CUBE and GROUPING SETS give you flexible subtotal combinations
